texts.preamble: Xavier George vs The Secretary on 12 February, 2026 Wp(C) No. 38006 Of 2025 :1: 2026:Ker:12933 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr.Justice Ziyad Rahman A.A. Thursday, The 12Th Day Of February 2026 / 23Rd Magha, 1947 Wp(C) No. 38006 Of 2025 Petitioner: Xavier George, Aged 51 Years, S/O.George, Residing At T.C 14/ 758, Observatory Lane, Ovra-9Ai, Museum,Vikasbhavan P.O., Palayam, Thiruvananthapuram, Pin - 695033 By Advs. Shri.S.Jathin Das Shri.Arun S. Smt.S.Agila Shri.T.A.Prakash Respondents: 1 The Secretary, State Planning Board, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram, Pin - 695001 2 Senior Administrative Officer, State Planning Board, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram, Pin - 695001 By Adv Shri.Binoy Davis, G.P This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On 12.02.2026, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: Wp(C) No. 38006 Of 2025 :2: 2026:Ker:12933 Xavier George vs The Secretary on 12 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191045271/ 1 Judgment
texts.facts: The petitioner who had entered into an agreement with the 2nd respondent, for running a canteen in the office premises of the 1st respondent, has approached this Court seeking the following reliefs:- i) To issue a writ of mandamus or any other writ, order or direction, directing the respondents to allow the petitioner to continue to the canteen on the basis of Exhibit P1 agreement; ii) To declare that Exhibit P5 notice issued by the 2nd respondent within a span of 10 months of Exhibit P1 is illegal and unsustainable; iii) To command the respondents to provide an opportunity to hear the side of the petitioner; 2. The challenge is against Ext.P5 notice by which the petitioner was required to stop the functioning of the canteen with effect from 18.10.2025. One of the main grounds raised by the petitioner is that, the petitioner was not heard, before the said decision is taken. 3. A detailed counter affidavit has been submitted by the petitioner. Several documents which ultimately led to the respondents to arrive at a decision to terminate the contract, WP(C) NO. 38006 OF 2025 :3: 2026:KER:12933 have been furnished. It is discernible there from that, Ext.P5 order was passed without hearing the petitioner.
